content: Merikɨtsɨ kepauka 'Itsiwutseti Tsahuri nu'aya mɨpaɨ mɨretima kename 'Awinexi Hewuruni paitɨ hemieriekai, 'ana kaniutimani meta 'ixaheritsixi yunaitɨ.

'Itsiwutseti teɨteri yuhutame kaniwarexeiyakaitɨni, kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni. Xewitɨ Wanaha katinitewakaitɨni, xewitɨta Xekawi, mɨkɨ meyuhutatɨ Ximuni niwemama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai Weruti kiekame, mɨkɨ Wenikamini mepɨnuiwarimamatɨkai. Weruti Wenikamini kwieyaritsie pɨrawiyakai.
Weruti kiekatari meripaitɨ Kitahini mepuyuta'unaxɨ, hikɨ 'akuxi mana mekanetiteni.

Kunatani Tsahuri nu'aya xeime yuniwe kanexeiyakaitɨni 'auxɨwime wiyari hexeiyakame Mepiwutseti titewakame muti'ɨtsaiwakai. Kepauka Ketsireri tewi heyeyaka mɨtiwarutaxatɨa kename Tsahuri meta Kunatani mehekwi'iwakai, mi'ɨwiyakai kaniyuta'unakaitɨni 'etutɨ, peru yumexɨitɨarikakɨ kanixuawa, 'ayumieme hurietɨ kanayani.
Hikɨ Xekawi meta Wanaha Ximuni Weruti kiekame niwemama, 'Itsiwutseti kie mekanekɨne, hikɨ tuka 'amɨtiɨxɨkatsie mekaniu'axɨani, mɨkɨ kepauka mutikukutsutsie.
'Ukaratsi kitenie tihɨweme kaneukuni tɨriku henatɨ, hikɨ mana mɨpaɨ mekatenanutakɨne Xekawi Wanaha matɨa 'awie kiita paitɨ.
Kepauka 'upaitɨ memeutahaxɨa 'Itsiwutseti kanikutsukaitɨni yu'utatsie. Muwa mekaneititseixɨani mekanimieni, hikɨ mu'uya mehanutixiteka mekaneituni. Mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie 'Arawa makumawetsie mekaniuyekɨne,

hikɨ Hewuruni meye'axɨaka Rawiri 'Itsiwutseti mu'uya mekaniyetuirieni mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —Neuxei 'ekɨ ti'aitame: 'Ena 'Itsiwutseti mu'uya tekamaniye'atɨirieka, Tsahuri mɨmatsi'aye'uniekai nu'aya muyutatexi matsi miemɨtɨ. Yawé hikɨ katinikɨhɨwirieni 'ekɨ ti'aitame 'ahetsiemieme, Tsahuri meta nuiwarimama kememɨmatsiyurikukai hepaɨtsita.
Hikɨ Rawiri mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya Xekawi meta Wanaha Ximuni niwemama Weruti kiekame: —Yurikɨ Yawé hɨxie mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, 'aixɨa mɨnetsi'uyuri ne'uximatɨarikatsie,

meripaitɨ xewitɨ pɨnetiutaxatɨa kename Tsahuri hemɨkai, 'aixɨa ti'aneme netiutaxatɨame puyu'eriekai, peru ne tixaɨtɨ nepɨkatipitɨa, matsi nekanita'aita mɨhɨiyanikɨ meta mɨmierienikɨ mana Tsikɨraki kiekariyaritsie.
Matsi yemekɨ kareuyewetse xeme nemɨxekwini teyukwikate 'atsikatiyurieneme xemumikɨ mexi kutsukai yu'utatsie. 'Ayumieme xekatenayukatuakuni xemimikɨ. Nekanixekumaweriyamɨkɨ 'ena kwiepa.

Hikɨ Rawiri yukuyaxima katiniwaruta'aitɨani memɨwakwinikɨ meta wamamate wa'ɨkate memanuxitexɨanikɨ, hikɨ Hewuruni kiekariyaritsie haa mayemarike 'aurie wakaxari mekaniuyewɨtɨani. Matsi 'Itsiwutseti mu'uya Hewuruni mekanikateuku 'Awinexi makateukietsie.
